name: Create valid extern instance with no control_params
setup: sh -c 'for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/ptables 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$output" >&2; exit "$rc"'
